top.line: What the Sovereign Website hub shows: 33 live sites from one pipeline, and a theme emerging.

in-short.line: The hub, 33 sites, every kind, the same bones, each improving the next.

hub.line: Websites their owners own: 33 working, 11 people's sites, one handed over, seven groups.

people.line: Actors, a designer, a founder, a musician, AI builders: each from their own material, often in five designs.

startups.line: Independent brochures for our startups, a Mistral guide, a whois tool, Google Maps on the owner's key.

places.line: Made-up businesses, the PrompTugal news family, the pipeline explained, a simulated billboard.

theme.line: Own address and repository, designs, start and AI pages, sources, credits, no tracking: the pattern as product.

limits.line: The hub's counts on 21 November; one handed over; some sites made up.

sources.line: The hub, its data and its sites, read on 21 November 2026.
